content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p10","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The salt pans glitter like a thousand tiny mirrors under Inti (the sun)."},{"poi_id":"p11","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The terraces sink into the earth like a giant's amphitheatre, and the mountain air hums around you."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The cathedral holds centuries of stories in its stone and gold."},{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Cacao from bean to bar, with a sweet smell that pulls you in."},{"poi_id":"p13","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Under the dome, the southern sky opens up like a slow, glittering story."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Giant Inca stones fitted like a puzzle, with a view over the whole city."},{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A riot of colours, fruit juices and woven things under one old roof."},{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"Wander the little lanes where artisans keep their doors open and the walls lean a bit."},{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Gold, textiles and stories of the Inca inside a quiet colonial courtyard."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The old square hums with stone arches and Andean light, a fine first breath of Cusco."},{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"Inca walls once clad in gold, now a quiet courtyard where two worlds meet."},{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A white guardian above the red roofs, perfect for watching Inti (the sun) dip behind the hills."},{"poi_id":"p15","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Garden tables and honest plant-based plates, a gentle welcome to the highlands."}]}
Your guide in Cusco, at your service: gold light, Inca stones, starry skies, salt and terraces — every must-do tucked in, nice and warm.
